key.phasecraft.toggle_layer: Go into / out of the hidden layer
phasecraft.layer.entered: Inside the hidden layer: the visible world is shown see-through (%1$s to go back, %2$s to hide it)
phasecraft.layer.refused: Only Creative and Spectator players can go into the hidden layer (it has no ground)
phasecraft.layer.none: This dimension has no hidden layer
phasecraft.layer.no_server: This server does not have PhaseCraft's hidden layer key
phasecraft.inside.on: Visible world shown see-through: on (%s%% opaque)
phasecraft.edit.on: Editing the hidden layer: clicks place and break hidden blocks (J to stop)
phasecraft.guard.moved_out: Moved back to the visible layer: only Creative and Spectator players can be in the hidden layer (it has no ground)
phasecraft.guard.no_respawn: You cannot set your respawn point in the hidden layer
phasecraft.edit.not_allowed: Editing the hidden layer needs Creative, or Survival with the game rule phasecraft:survival_access on
phasecraft.edit.no_beds: Beds and respawn anchors cannot be used in the hidden layer
gamerule.phasecraft.area_shifters: Area shifters work (two corners switch a box of the world off and on)
gamerule.phasecraft.phased_lights: Hidden lights on phase blocks light the visible world
gamerule.phasecraft.survival_access: Survival players can see and edit the hidden layer
phasecraft.tooltip.hidden: Works in the hidden layer: place it in editing mode (J)
block.phasecraft.phase_port.tooltip.1: Carries power both ways between the layers
block.phasecraft.phase_piston.tooltip.1: Pushes visible blocks, with no visible arm
block.phasecraft.sticky_phase_piston.too: Pushes and pulls visible blocks, with no visible arm
block.phasecraft.phase_block.tooltip.1: A button, lever, plate, light, observer, comparator,
block.phasecraft.phase_block.tooltip.2: tripwire hook, hopper or dropper on it works
block.phasecraft.phase_block.tooltip.3: with the visible world at its own spot
block.phasecraft.phase_shifter.tooltip.1: Powered: takes the visible block at its spot away
block.phasecraft.line_shifter.tooltip.1: Powered: takes the line in front of it away, a block at a time
block.phasecraft.line_shifter.tooltip.2: Unpowered: puts it back. Click it to change its speed
block.phasecraft.area_shifter.tooltip.1: Two at opposite corners take a box of the world away
block.phasecraft.area_shifter.tooltip.2: while both are powered. Click: speed
